n1.speaker: dawson
n1.text: Hello there. What can I do for you?

translations.fa: سلام. چه کمکی از دستم برمیاد؟

branches.suggestion: Hi. I've got a sore throat and a cough.
I think I've caught a cold.

cultureNote.en: British vs American: chemist / pharmacy (UK) = drugstore (US). "Chemist's" is very common in Britain.

n2.speaker: dawson
n2.text: Oh dear. How long have you had it? Have you got a temperature?

translations.fa: ای وای. چند وقته داریدش؟ تب دارید؟

branches.suggestion: About three days. No temperature, I think.
branches.suggestionFa: حدود سه روز. فکر کنم تب ندارم.

branches.suggestion: Since Monday. I feel a bit hot.
branches.suggestionFa: از دوشنبه. یه کم احساس گرما می‌کنم.

n3.speaker: dawson
n3.text: Right. You should drink lots of water and you should rest. These lozenges will help your throat.

translations.fa: خب. باید زیاد آب بخورید و استراحت کنید. این قرص‌های مکیدنی به گلوتون کمک می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: How often should I take them?
branches.suggestionFa: هر چند وقت یه بار بخورمشون؟

n4.speaker: dawson
n4.text: One every three hours. And yes, paracetamol is fine. But you shouldn't take more than eight a day.

translations.fa: هر سه ساعت یکی. و آره، پاراستامول اشکالی نداره. ولی نباید روزی بیشتر از هشتا بخورید.

branches.suggestion: OK, I understand. Not more than eight.
branches.suggestionFa: باشه، فهمیدم. نه بیشتر از هشتا.

branches.suggestion: Should I go to work tomorrow?

n5.speaker: dawson
n5.text: If you feel poorly, you should stay at home. And if it isn't better in a week, you should see your GP.

translations.fa: اگه حالتون بده، باید خونه بمونید. و اگه تا یه هفته بهتر نشد، باید برید پیش پزشک عمومی.

cultureNote.en: "Poorly" is a very British word for ill, especially in the north of England.

n6.speaker: dawson
n6.text: That's six pounds fifty, please. Get well soon, love!

translations.fa: میشه شش پوند و پنجاه پنس. زود خوب شی عزیزم!
